messages.author: Jiang, Wei
messages.body:
Hi, I see free version amber24 does not install pmemd.cuda. I am a new user of amber. Since which version amber program pmemd.cuda is installed by licensed version only?
Wei

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Sat, Dec 14, 2024, Jiang, Wei via AMBER wrote:
>
>Hi, I see free version amber24 does not install pmemd.cuda. I am a new user
>of amber. Since which version amber program pmemd.cuda is installed by
>licensed version only?
pmemd.cuda is included.  You just need to set INSTALL_CUDA=TRUE in your
run_cmake script.
....dac

messages.author: Adrian Roitberg
messages.body:
What do you exactly mean by free ?
Ambertools does NOT have the cuda version, but if you download the Full
Amber suite from the ambermd.org site, you will get it there.
You need to fill out a license agreement, but it is free to academics.
Adrian

messages.author: Jiang, Wei
messages.body:
Hi, now I have both AmberTools24.tar.bz2 and Amber24.tar.bz2 downloaded. After I extracted them, I get two "amber24_src" folders.
In the amber24_src extracted from Amber24.tar.bz2, it shows "benchmarks  examples  README  src  test;
in the amber24_src extracted from AmberTools24.tar.bz2, it shows "AmberTools  build  cmake  CMakeLists.txt  cmake-packaging  compile_with_hip.sh  dat  README  recipe_at  test  update_amber  updateutils".
So how to combine them together to build?
Previously I merely extracted AmberTools24.tar.bz2 and run "run_cmake".
Thanks!
Wei
